title: SyncResult
description: What a sync fetched, stored and spent.

source.description: The name of the bound source.

added.description: Items that were new to the store.

updated.description: Items that replaced a stored one.

skipped.description: Items the store did not keep, such as ids deleted earlier.

cost.description: What the fetches of this sync cost.

more.description: Whether the source had more ready when maxItems or the monthly cap stopped the sync; true when the cap stopped it before its first fetch, since it could not ask.

selectorChanged.description: Whether the configured selector differed from the last sync's, in which case this sync started again from the beginning of its window.

stopped.description: Why the sync stopped before the source ran out or maxItems was reached; left out when it did not stop early. monthly cap: what the store's monthlyUsd leaves this month is less than one more page could cost, so nothing more was fetched or stored.

monthlyCap.description: The allowance that stopped the sync, given with stopped.

month.description: The calendar month in UTC, as YYYY-MM.

capUsd.description: The monthly cap on this source in US dollars.

spentUsd.description: US dollars spent on this source this month, this sync included.

remainingUsd.description: What the cap still leaves, less than one page costs.
